content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NSU Manipur Project Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Lab Technician post at NSU Manipur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Lab Technician role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed high school or equivalent, along with a two-year diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician or a bachelor's degree in medical laboratory technology with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Lab Technician position is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project Lab Technician job at NSU Manipur?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to the designated email address, along with your resume and required documents, before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent or temporary position?
faq.answer: The Project Lab Technician position is a temporary role, as indicated in the job notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is INLEADS-02/2025.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening and verification, followed by an interview which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the National Sports University Manipur website, www.nsu.ac.in.
